name: trove-packages
description: Monorepo for the publishable Trove authoring packages: @ontrove/sdk, @ontrove/mcp, and @ontrove/cli.
author: Hollyburn Analytics Inc.

scripts.build: bun run --filter './packages/trove-sdk' --filter './packages/trove-mcp' build && bun run --filter './packages/trove-cli' build
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run lint && bun run lint:knip && bun run lint:baseline && bun run typecheck && bun run test:coverage && bun run refs:check && bun run docs:examples
